player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id} ed **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Isumite'y iyong galaw a **[macro  micro]** (duaran numero 0-8):
• *macro*  = panon mini-board so iyong galawan
• *micro* = panon kuadrado ed abayag na mini-board
Halimbawa `[7 8]` ➜ itayak'y iyong marka ed mini-board 7, kuadrado 8, tan
piliten'y iyong kalaban a galawen ed mini-board 8 sumunad.

Sika'y `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say move et nepeg ya onkana ed porma na [macro micro] a walaay numero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Amin ya index et nepeg a walad baetan na 0 tan 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Say micro board, agew, o kolumna et wala lad sakop.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Say manlalaban so nepeg a mila ed onsublay ya micro board.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Aalagaren tayo lay panalo ed satan a board.

game_action.played: Managpapat {player_id} so galawen ed micro board {macro_idx}, selula {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Managpapat {opponent_id} nayarin galawen ed {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Say manlalaban {player_id} so analo ed Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
